title: To the heart of Europe where magic is found
dek: Vienna's food scene is amazing to say the least
author: Daniel Mansfield

blocks.text: Recently, I have moved to Vienna where my wife is living and I have since hailed from Chicago where the food scene is top-notch. I did not know just how good the food culture would be until I dove right in and was open to everything. Vienna is really known to have a super good coffee culture and you could find good coffee in just about any one of their 21 districts.

Let me elaborate on the coffee and why this is a must if there is any bit of a little reason to come to Vienna. You think that you have tried good coffee? Austria's capital will challenge your beliefs. What makes Vienna's coffee so good is the Alpine water (yes the water you put in your coffee makes a difference ). Second, it’s the extended living room feeling in just about any coffee shop that you go into. You know that place inside a house where you are not pressured to leave or rushed? The cafes have this feel to them. I only leave because I have other things to do throughout the day, not because someone is asking you constantly if you are going to order or if you want anything else.

As I have stated before, I am from the great city of Chicago where we hold a badge of honor for our pizza culture. As I did not find anything like Chicago in Vienna (yet), I have found some great Nepalese pizza that keeps me coming back. Now, will you have to eat your pizza with a fork and knife? Yes. Will you experience the flavors of the sauce and cheese and fresh vegetables? Absolutely. I found most of the pizza places to be nice and quaint. Ambiance is warm and you feel like you are in a living room with strangers eating pizza.

Budget the conversation early and directly, even though it's the least fun part. A trip that quietly assumes everyone's comfortable with the same green fees and lodging tier is the most common way a group trip turns awkward later. Thirty seconds of directness up front saves a lot of passive-aggressive group chat messages afterward.

None of this is complicated, which is sort of the point — the trips that actually happen aren't the ones with the best course list, they're the ones where somebody just made the decisions instead of waiting for consensus.
